end.summary: Discussed “unity in diversity” and how differences can enrich society.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining unity in diversity using singing, teamwork, instruments, and festivals as examples. They identified differences in festival practices while also noticing shared feelings such as joy and gratitude. Riya still mixed up the idea by saying festivals can cause fights, and this was not corrected after the last mention. At home, ask Riya to name one difference and one shared feature in two festivals, foods, languages, or types of dress.
